correctness.rationale: Headline inequality mu_j(T_0.1(C5))<=1-1/40 for large t_j is TRUE as a corollary of qualitative QUE, and geometry/majorant pointwise computations verify. Re-ran all artifacts: geom.py GEOM_OK confirmed L0=1.9248473002384138, 2cosh(L0/2)=3, vol=pi/3, A(r)=2L0 sinh r ratios 0.36823/0.55349/0.74014 at r=0.1/0.15/0.2, collar half-width arcsinh(1/sinh(L0/2))=0.8047>>0.15 so T_0.15 embedded, gap 0.975-0.55349=0.42150. Majorant Theta0=s((0.15-|v|)/0.05) with s=6x^5-15x^4+10x^3: max|s'|=30/16=1.875 at x=1/2 and max|s''|=10/sqrt(3)=5.7735 at 1/2+/-sqrt(3)/6 verified, hence |Theta0'|<=37.5 exact and |Theta0''|<=2309.41<=2309.5 claimed. Since 1_{T_0.1}<=Theta0<=1_{T_0.15}, m(Theta0)<=A(0.15)/vol<=0.5535; Lindenstrauss measure classification + Soundararajan no-escape gives <mu_j,Theta0>->m(Theta0) for compactly supported continuous Theta0, so limsup mu_j(T_0.1)<=0.5535<0.975. Systole identification (matrix [[2,1],[1,1]] det 1 tr 3, tr 3 minimal hyperbolic as integer traces <2/=2/>2 are elliptic/parabolic/hyperbolic) and tube-area/collar formulas are standard and correct. Restriction-form overclaim is explicitly disavowed (Sec.5 caveat). Stirling pointwise values verified: A(t)*t=12.56699/12.56652/12.56640/12.56637 at t=50/100/200/1000 ->4pi, and stirling_bound.py pointwise Olver-remainder enclosures (width ~1e-10) prove A(t)<=13/t at sampled points. Uniform claim K_arch(t)<=100 t^{-1}(log t)^3 for ALL t>=50 is not fully proved from discrete samples (no inter-sample derivative/uniform argument; tail monotonicity asserted without proof) and the absorption C(psi_k)*13(log t)^2<=100(log t)^3 uniform over Sobolev cutoff growing with t_j is unjustified — but this lemma is not needed for the unconditional headline, which does not use Watson-Ichino at all. Conditional part (b) is explicitly conditional on open diagonal hypotheses H(delta_sub,A) and threshold.py delivers only a hypothetical schema (e.g. C=10,d=0.1 gives t*~9e17; C=100,d=0.02 gives t*~8e136), i.e. no concrete effective T*; as a conditional existence claim following from cited Bisain Thm 1.1 it is logically vacuous but not false, and limitations honestly disclose non-effective threshold, open H, HMN failure, and non-interval nature of Stirling enclosure. Hence headline is proved; defects are in auxiliary effective chain, noted as residual risk, not headline falsity.

originality.rationale: No prior source states the literal numbers (C5, r0=0.1, 1-1/40, K_arch<=100...), confirmed by admission triage and fetched abstracts (Watson 0810.0425 general triple identities; Bisain et al 2402.14050 general effective QUE from subconvexity; HMN 2207.14449 general subconvexity unless completely related; Soundararajan 0901.4060 qualitative QUE). Substantive comparison shows the headline is mechanically implied by known theorems, i.e. parameter substitution, not a new result: qualitative QUE implies <mu_j,Theta>->m(Theta) for EVERY fixed compactly supported continuous Theta, so for any fixed tube of Liouville fraction <0.975 (here 0.368) the cap <=0.975 for large j follows without any Watson-Ichino, archimedean, or subconvexity work. Fixing the general theorem to (C5,Theta0) and computing volume ratio to 50 digits adds no mathematical content beyond choosing a bump majorant. The archimedean cap is routine Stirling (A(t)~4pi/t via |Gamma(1/2+it)|^2=pi/cosh(pi t)); constant 100 is arbitrary slack over true ~12.57, not a new estimate. The HMN P=O(1) obstruction restates HMN's own hypothesis ('not completely related' / conductor-dropping fails in diagonal QUE-like case pi2~tilde pi1), explicitly discussed in HMN. The defined ratio R_j is a tautological rearrangement, not a proved sharpness lemma. A timestamp or failed arXiv search does not establish priority; substantive novelty is absent.

value.rationale: Headline judged separately from unfinished survey per narrow-datum policy, but fails the policy's three conditions for a retrievable exact invariant. (i) Object C5/r0 are natural, but invariant 1-1/40=0.975 is not motivated before computation: true QUE limit is ~0.368 (tube fraction), so 0.975 is an extremely weak, arbitrary threshold (any number in (0.5535,1) would work identically; 1/40 has no extremal, rate, or defect-measure significance). (ii) Value is mechanically implied: qualitative QUE already gives the far stronger limit 0.5535, so a future researcher needing tube mass would retrieve QUE + volume, not this cap. (iii) No precise fact is needed later: unconditional threshold is non-effective (no j0), effective T* is conditional on open H with vacuous schema values (1e17 to 1e235) and no concrete exponent imported (HMN supplies no saving, admitted), so nothing can be imported by a QUE-rate/entropy/restriction argument beyond what Bisain/Watson already provide generally. K_arch constant 100 is slack certification of an arbitrary majorization, not a sharp or reusable bridge — certification alone does not rescue an unexplained number. Result is textbook restatement (qualitative QUE applied to a bump) + mere parameter substitution (general effective QUE specialized to Theta0) + tiny unmotivated gain (weak cap far above true mass), explicitly rejectable even if correct and new. No ADMISSION_DEFECT reopening needed; value fails on ordinary standard with no presumption.
